meta.title: SSO / SAML 2.0: on failure — SSO errors logged
gaps: Configure the INT-003 SSO / SAML 2.0 integration with the specified provider, entity ID, SSO URL, certificate, and role mapping
Make the external SAML provider fail or become unreachable
Trigger a Procol login through SAML SSO
Observe and verify the resulting SSO error log, alert, state, or retry record and confirm it was not silently dropped
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the INT-003 SSO / SAML 2.0 integration with the specified provider, entity ID, SSO URL, certificate, and role mapping; Make the external SAML provider fail or become unreachable; Trigger a Procol login through SAML SSO; Observe and verify the resulting SSO error log, alert, state, or retry record and confirm it was not silently dropped

args.need: configure the SAML 2.0 integration, make the external provider fail or become unreachable, attempt login through Procol SSO, and provide evidence that the SSO error was logged without being silently dropped
